newsitem.title: USA: Gillette reports record results for the third quarter.
newsitem.headline: Gillette reports record results for the third quarter.

text.p: Gillette Co. said Thursday it posted record profits and sales in the third quarter.

The maker of razors, shaving cream and other products said it earned $242 million, or 54 cents a share, on sales of $1.80 billion. A year earlier, the company earned $202 million, or 46 cents a share, on sales of $1.67 billion.
The earnings were about in line with the 53 cents a share that Wall Street had expected, according to estimates compiled by First Call.

"This record performance represents the 25th consecutive quarter that our earnings per share, excluding special charges taken in 1993, have increased at a double-digit rate, with growth in each of the last twelve quarters having exceeded 15 percent," Chairman Alfred Zeien said.
Sales and profits grew in razors and blades, toiletries and cosmetics, stationery and products with the Braun brand name, Gillette said.
For the first nine months, Gillette earned $696 million, or $1.56 a share, on sales of $5.23 billion. A year earlier, the company earned $591 million, or $1.33 a share, on sales of $4.81 billion.
Gillette stock rose 37.5 cents to $73.625 on the New York Stock Exchange. The company reported results after the close of regular trading.
